description: This file defines the Layout class within the Opencart admin controller namespace. It manages CRUD operations, listing, and rendering views related to layout entities in the Opencart admin panel, including handling form submissions, pagination, and permission checks.

classes.name: Layout
classes.description: Controller class for managing layout entities in the Opencart admin panel, including list, form, save, and delete operations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for displaying the layout list page.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the AJAX request to get the list of layouts.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for the list of layouts, with sorting, pagination, and related data.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a layout, populating data as needed.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the form submission to create or update a layout, returning JSON with success or errors.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected layouts after permission checks and dependency validation, returning JSON status.
